notes: `composer setup` (composer.json:89-95) is the one-command setup: copies .env.example to .env if missing, php artisan key:generate, php artisan migrate --seed, npm install, npm run build. So env-copy, key:generate, migrate, db:seed, install:npm and build-assets all happen inside script:setup. Caveat: .env.example has no DB_CONNECTION and config/database.php:20 defaults to sqlite, so unless the developer adds DB_CONNECTION=mysql the app silently uses a SQLite file named 'laravel' (DB_DATABASE) instead of the MySQL database the README asks for; the maintainer agent script adds DB_CONNECTION=mysql (.agents/setup:87). The template's DB_USERNAME=root / DB_PASSWORD=password must match the local MySQL. PHP pinned to 8.5.* (composer.json:7); Node 24.x (package.json engines, README, CI). npm with package-lock.json (CI: npm ci). `npm run dev` (README Commands table) is optional because setup already builds assets. Seeded login: testing / password. Herd users have polyscope.json (herd link, migrate, storage:link, npm install), not referenced by the README.
